content.thinking:
Now the big test file covering field rules, authority grammar, framing, cookies, content-length, duplicates, trailers.

Let me build a generic runner that takes fields and returns the status.

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/t2.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

ROUTES = {'https://demo.test': 'r1', 'http://a.test': 'r2',
          'http://a.test:80': 'r3', 'https://demo.test:443': 'r3b',
          'https://[2001:db8::1]': 'r4', 'http://10.0.0.1': 'r5',
          'http://a-b.test': 'r6'}
def one(fields, data=None, trailing=None, routes=ROUTES, sid=0):
    ev = stream(sid, fields, data=data, trailing=trailing)
    return run({'routes': routes, 'events': ev})['streams'][0]['status']

F = base_fields
R = ROUTES
def expect_reject(fields, **kw):
    got = one(fields, **kw)
    assert got == 'rejected', 'expected rejected, got %s for %r %r' % (got, fields, kw)
def expect_fwd(fields, **kw):
    got = one(fields, **kw)
    assert got == 'forwarded', 'expected forwarded, got %s for %r %r' % (got, fields, kw)

# ---------- methods
for m in ['GET','HEAD','POST','PUT','PATCH','DELETE','OPTIONS']:
    expect_fwd(F(method=m, path='*' if m=='OPTIONS' else '/'))
for m in ['get','Get','TRACE','CONNECT','PATCH2','MKCOL','']:
    expect_reject(F(method=m, path='/'))

# ---------- schemes
for s in ['http','https']:
    expect_fwd(F(scheme=s, authority='a.test', path='/'))
for s in ['HTTP','https ','ftp','wss','']:
    expect_reject(F(scheme=s, authority='a.test', path='/'))

# ---------- paths
for p in ['/', '/a', '/a/b/c', '/a%2Fb?x=1&x=2', '/%aa/%AB', "/a.b~c$d&e'f(g)h*i+j,k;l=m:n@o/p?q=r",
          '/-._~!$&\'()*+,;=:@/?', '/a?b', '/#'.replace('#','x')]:
    expect_fwd(F(path=p))
for p in ['*', '//', '/a//b', '/a b', '/a\tb', '/a%2', '/a%zz', '/a%', '/a\\b', '/a#frag',
          '', '/\xe9', '/a\x00', 'http://x/', 'http:x', './a', '/a?', '/a?', 'http://x']:
    expect_reject(F(path=p))
expect_reject(F(method='GET', path='*'))
expect_reject(F(method='POST', path='*'))
expect_fwd(F(method='OPTIONS', path='*'))
expect_fwd(F(method='OPTIONS', path='/x'))

# ---------- pseudo-headers
expect_reject(F() + [[':method','GET']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],['x-a','1'],[':authority','demo.test']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],[':foo','x']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],[':authority','a'],[':authority','a']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','demo.test']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':authority','demo.test'],[':path','/']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],[':','x']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],[':path','/']])
expect_fwd([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','demo.test'],[':path','/']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],['host','a.test'],[':authority','demo.test']])

# ---------- authority/host presence
expect_fwd([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],['host','demo.test']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],['host','demo.test'],['host','demo.test']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],[':authority','demo.test'],[':authority','demo.test']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],[':authority','demo.test'],['host','demo.test.']])
expect_fwd([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],[':authority','demo.test'],['host','demo.test']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],[':authority',''],['host','']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],['host','']])
expect_reject([[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],[':authority','']])

# ---------- authority grammar
for a in ['demo.test','DEMO.TEST','a-b.test','a.b.c.test','123.test','a1-b2.test',
          'x'*63 + '.com', ('ab.'*40) + 'example.com',
          '10.0.0.1','255.255.255.255','0.0.0.0','0.00.0.0'.replace('00','1'),
          '1.2.3.4:8080','demo.test:80','demo.test:443','demo.test:00080','demo.test:65535',
          'demo.test:1','[2001:db8::1]','[::1]','[::ffff:192.0.2.1]','[2001:db8::1]:8443',
          '[::ffff:c000:201]','[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]','[2001:0db8:0000::1]']:
    expect_fwd(F(authority=a, scheme='http' if a.lower().startswith(('10.','0.','1.')) and ':' not in a and '[' not in a else 'https'))
for a in ['demo.test.','_bad.test','-bad.test','bad-.test','bad_test','ba d.test','ba\td.test',
          'demo..test','.demo.test','demo.test:','demo.test:0','demo.test:00000','demo.test:65536',
          'demo.test:08080'.replace('08080','065536'),'demo.test:-1','demo.test:+80','demo.test:123456',
          'demo.test:80:90','1.2.3.04','256.1.1.1','999.1.1.1','1.2.3','1.2.3.4.5.6',
          '[2001:db8::1','2001:db8::1','[fe80::1%eth0]','[]','demo.test%20',
          'x'*254, 'x'*64 + '.com', 'a'*64+'.com',
          'us\u00e9r.test', 'demo.test:80 ', '[::1]:', '[::1]x', '[::1]:80x',
          '10.0.0.256', '01.2.3.4', '00.2.3.4']:
    expect_reject(F(authority=a, scheme='https'))
expect_fwd(F(authority='x'*253, scheme='https'))
expect_reject(F(authority='x'*254, scheme='https'))

# ---------- field names/values
for n in ['a','a-b','a_b','a.b','a~b','a!b','a$b','a0b','x-list-a','cookie','content-length','te',
          "a#b","a%b","a&b","a'b","a*b","a+b","a^b","a`b","a|b"]:
    expect_fwd(F(extra=[(n, 'v')]))
for n in ['A','a b','a,b','a;b','a/b','a:b','a=b','a?b','a@b','a[b','a"b','a<b','a{b','a(b','a)b','',
          'a\tb','a\nb','.a','']:
    expect_reject(F(extra=[(n, 'v')]))
expect_reject(F(extra=[('A-B','v')]))
for v in ['v',' v ', '\tv\t', 'a b c', 'a\tb', '\xe9', 'x'*8000, 'a\x7f', '', 'a\x00b', 'a\nb', 'a\rb',
          ' a', 'a ', 'a\x1f', 'a\x80b', '\x7f']:
    if v in ('a\x7f','a\x00b','a\nb','a\rb',' a','a ','a\x1f','\x7f'):
        expect_reject(F(extra=[('x-v', v)]))
    else:
        expect_fwd(F(extra=[('x-v', v)]))
expect_reject(F(extra=[('x-v', 'a\x7fb')]))
expect_fwd(F(extra=[('x-v', 'a\x7f'.replace('\x7f','\x7f'))]) if False else F())
expect_reject(F(extra=[('x-v', '\x7fa')]))
expect_fwd(F(extra=[('x-v', 'a\xa0b')]))

# ---------- prohibited / te
for n in ['connection','proxy-connection','keep-alive','transfer-encoding','upgrade',
          'http2-settings','trailer']:
    expect_reject(F(extra=[(n, '')]))
    expect_reject(F(extra=[(n, 'x')]))
expect_fwd(F(extra=[('te','trailers')]))
expect_reject(F(extra=[('te','trailers'), ('te','trailers')]))
expect_reject(F(extra=[('te','Trailers')]))
expect_reject(F(extra=[('te','trailers, x')]))
expect_reject(F(extra=[('te','identity')]))
expect_fwd(F(extra=[('te','trailers'),('cookie','a=1')]))

# ---------- repeats
for n in ['accept','accept-encoding','cache-control','if-match','if-none-match','pragma','vary',
          'x-list-a','x-list-1','x-list-x-list']:
    expect_fwd(F(extra=[(n,'1'),(n,'2'),(n,'3')]))
expect_reject(F(extra=[('x-list-','1'),('x-list-','2')]))
expect_fwd(F(extra=[('x-list-','1')]))
expect_reject(F(extra=[('x-a','1'),('x-a','2')]))
expect_reject(F(extra=[('content-type','a'),('content-type','b')]))
expect_reject(F(extra=[('accept','1'),('x-a','1'),('x-a','2')]))
expect_fwd(F(extra=[('accept','1'),('accept','2'),('x-a','1')]))

summary()
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/t2.py 2>&1 | tail -30
